projects.title: Edugamehub1
bullets: Coordinated the buildout of a mobile-first, offline-capable learning platform for rural STEM students using React, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS.
Set up continuous integration to catch build errors before they reached the multilingual interface, reducing last-minute merge surprises.

projects.title: Bustracker
bullets: Built a real-time bus tracking system with Flask and GPS data, applying pandas and scikit-learn to estimate arrival distances.
Iterated on early distance estimates after inconsistent GPS signals produced unreliable results, tightening the calculation until accuracy stabilized.

projects.title: NER Explorer
bullets: Built an open-source tool that turns RSS news feeds into an interactive knowledge graph using spaCy, pandas, and Streamlit.
Documented setup steps clearly enough that a classmate reproduced the pipeline without asking a follow-up question.

leadership.title: Project Coordinator
bullets: Noticed that project teams often restarted work after unclear task ownership, and introduced a shared checklist assigning owners and deadlines.
Realized that coordinating handoffs between teammates interested her more than writing any single feature herself.
